claims.text: CBS News, 60 Minutes, correspondent Bill Whitaker, published 16 May 2021, states that Dietrich, a former F/A-18F pilot, 'has never before spoken publicly about what she saw that day'. The same report quotes her: 'It was unidentified. And that's why it was so unsettling to us. Because we weren't expecting it. We couldn't classify it'; 'No predictable movement, no predictable trajectory'; and 'I felt the vulnerability of not having anything to defend ourselves. And then I felt confused when it disappeared.' This dates the start of her public record to 16 May 2021 on the network's own assertion.

title: CBS News, 60 Minutes, Bill Whitaker, 'Navy pilots describe encounters with UFOs'
